verdict.rationale: GitLab documents an official CLI (glab) at docs.gitlab.com/editor_extensions/gitlab_cli/, confirming an official CLI exists, but the evidence pack doesn't show AI-native-specific CLI capabilities (e.g., invoking Duo agents, MCP-related commands) beyond the general CLI's existence. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of AI-native/agentic features within the CLI itself, independent hands-on validation of CLI usage for AI workflows.
